arrival.SF: Departed Wed 09-02, arrived Melbourne Fri 09-04 — nine days out. Shanahan: "you don't feel normal until like the third or fourth day." (CBS Sports, 09-03)
arrival.LA: Departed Tue ~10pm PT, ~16h flight, arrived Thu 09-10 ~24h before kick; one practice 4:35pm AEST. McVay: "keep guys in as close to a rhythm and routine as possible." Rams under McVay abroad 3-0 SU/ATS (three London games, 8h shift, not 17h). (CBS Sports 09-03; ABC Australia 09-10)

not_playing.name: Alfred Collins
not_playing.note: OUT — torn patellar tendon at Tue 09-08 practice in Melbourne, season. Shanahan: "We've lost two D-linemen pretty much for the year." Halton/Thompson next up.

not_playing.name: Nick Bosa
not_playing.note: Plays; LP Tue+Wed (knee). Shanahan: "we've definitely got to be smart with that" — snap share capped, unquantified.

not_playing.name: George Kittle
not_playing.note: Plays; LP Tue+Wed (Achilles); same 'be smart' quote — workload uncertain.

not_playing.name: Brandon Aiyuk
not_playing.note: Reserve/left squad — not on roster (Lynch, 08-31). Pearsall out for year (PCL), Kirk out until ≥ Wk 5 (DK Network 09-08).

not_playing.name: Aaron Donald
not_playing.note: OUT — did not travel. McVay: "we're making a decision that we think is best for him and for our team." Week 2 targeted.
